content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Write-Off Transactions ## slug: write-off-transactions ## seoTitle: Write-Off Transactions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The new picklist value “Write Off” for the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} field is designed to deduct amounts from an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} while maintaining accurate records for financial reconciliation purposes. Users can define the process for creating write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s based on their unique requirements. Admins can implement write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s using tools such as Screen flows, Approval Processes, or other custom workflows to generate write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. Complete the following steps to create a new write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 1. From an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record page, click {{variable.button_new}} on the Transactions {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} to "Charge." 3. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 4. Add an amount to write off in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field. 5. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = "Write Off." 6. Check the {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}} checkbox. This is required to create a write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. If this field is left blank, an error message will be displayed. 7. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed." (This triggers the recalculation of {{variable.Object_Invoice}} totals). 8. Complete any other fields. (optional) 9. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. The new values will be reflected in the {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}}, {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalancePaid}}, and {{variable.Field_Invoice_BalanceDue}} {{variable.Object_Invoice}} fields. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](/v1/docs/troubleshooting-payments) page.
